moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio aurora-glow, written here): Behind a card: two blurred glows (radius ~41 px, blur 14 px, additive, opacity 0.55 / 0.5) circle opposite each other at offset (±24 px x, ±18 px y) along an angle swinging −1.3 → +1.3 rad, 1500 ms sine ping-pong; colours shift up to 70° in hue (red→blue, blue→green). The card on top stays still. Params: offset (±24 / ±18 px) · swing (±1.3 rad) · period (1.5 s mỗi chiều) · hue (70°).
